summary: Nissan Auto Receivables Company II LLC, as depositor, filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus for Nissan Auto Receivables 2026-B Owner Trust, a $1,285,670,000 auto-loan ABS issuance. Classes A-1 through C carry coupons from 4.235% to 5.52%, with A-2b floating at SOFR plus 0.33%, final maturities ranging October 2027 to June 2034, and monthly distributions beginning October 2026. Credit enhancement includes a reserve account, overcollateralization, a yield supplement overcollateralization amount, and subordination. Mizuho, BNP Paribas, BofA Securities and US Bancorp are underwriters. This is a routine structured-finance shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch auto ABS spread and collateral performance.
